project_description: Developed during my second year of college, Seatlify is one of my first major projects—a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) event management platform designed within a rigorous 12-week production timeline. Built as a Business-to-Business (B2B) solution, the platform focuses on a per-event market model featuring tiered packages based on attendee count to meet the core functional needs of the event management industry. The system is streamlined around three core features: personalized event creation, custom seat planning, and a comprehensive virtual ticketing and invitation system. This project serves as a focused EMS platform specifically tailored to transform manual event coordination into a seamless digital experience.

Winning first place at the 2026 CIIT Emerging Startup Convention (CESCON) was a definitive milestone, where I pitched and secured the top spot for my business startup concept. As the solo developer behind Seatlify, I conceptualized and built the web-based Event Management System to address real-world coordination challenges. This recognition at CESCON validates the platform's potential as a viable B2B solution and highlights my ability to bridge technical development with entrepreneurial strategy.
